artworks.title: The Raising of Lazarus
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a biblical scene with figures, architecture, and a landscape. It shows an ancient cityscape with architectural elements like arches, towers, and various buildings against a mountainous backdrop. In the foreground, figures are depicted in various poses, with some gesturing. A pathway extends into the distance, leading to more figures and structures under a partly cloudy sky. The drawing is detailed with linework showing texture in the figures' clothing and surroundings, resembling early European etchings.

artworks.title: Christ Heals the Sick
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a biblical scene with a group of figures and a landscape in the background. The scene involves a central figure standing among a gathering of individuals, with some kneeling and others gesturing attentively. The central figure is depicted with a halo. The figures around the central character seem to be engaged in a dialogue or listening intently. The mountainous landscape in the background features hills, trees, a small building, and a distant view of a city or fortress. The architectural elements and the arrangement of the figures suggest a narrative or instructional setting, typical of biblical or historical scenes in art from the Renaissance period.

artworks.title: The Chief Priests and Pharisees
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of sitting figures in a classical interior. The artwork depicts an architectural space with arches and pillars, and figures dressed in flowing robes gathered around a central figure. This setting is enclosed by decorated walls and columns, with the central figure elevated on a platform. The composition is symmetrical, with figures seemingly engaged in conversation or attentive to the central figure. The surroundings have a sense of depth, with the tiled floor guiding the eye towards the central point. The background through the arches shows a rural landscape.

artworks.title: Christ Blesses the Children
artworks.description: The image shows a group of people gathered together outdoors. A bearded man with long hair and robes is standing and gesturing with both arms. Surrounding him are other individuals, some standing and others in conversation. They are adults and children wearing clothing typical of the depicted time period. Women in long dresses are present, along with children reaching out to the adults. The background shows trees, an open field, and distant structures resembling a town or castle. There is no visible jewelry, but one woman is holding a child and the man is interacting with another child. The scene suggests an outdoor setting under large trees, with hills in the background.

artworks.title: Jesus the Obedient Son
artworks.description: This is a drawing depicting a rustic outdoor scene with figures engaging in various activities around a home. One figure is using a compass-like tool for measuring or alignment. Another figure is interacting with a basket, while a third figure is shown working on wood with a tool. The setting includes a small structure resembling a well or fountain, trees, hills, and a radiant sun.

artworks.title: Zacharias and the Angel of the Lord
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an architectural scene inside a classical structure. The image shows a detailed interior featuring arched ceilings supported by a series of ornate columns. At the center of the composition, there is a focus on an altar or significant structure with a domed top. Surrounding this central element are multiple robed figures positioned in various poses, some kneeling on the tiled floor. The architectural elements suggest a combination of classical and Renaissance influences, with perspective lines directing the viewer's eye toward the central structure. The background shows hills with distant structures. The complex formations of the ceiling, coupled with detailed elements, contribute to the atmosphere of the drawing.

artworks.title: The Preaching of John the Baptist in the Wilderness
artworks.description: This is a drawing depicting a group of people gathered in a pastoral setting near a wooded area and a building. The figures are dressed in historical attire and are engaged in various interactions. The background features dense trees and a large structure to the left of the scene. The drawing captures a significant moment within a narrative framework.

artworks.title: Christ Heals the Paralyzed Man
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an architectural interior featuring a gathering of figures around a central event. The drawing depicts a grand interior space with an elaborate arched ceiling supported by a series of columns. In the center of the composition are several figures clad in historical attire, gathered closely around an event occurring in the center. The columns create a sense of depth and structure, leading the viewer's eye toward a more distant part of the room, where a symmetrical layout provides balance to the scene. The intricate details in the figures' clothing and the architectural elements suggest a careful attention to detail. The presence of balconies and upper-level spectators further adds to the theatrical and grandiose nature of the scene.

artworks.title: Christ in the House of Mary and Martha
artworks.description: The image depicts multiple figures in a room. A standing woman is in the center, wearing a long dress with puffed sleeves. Next to her, a seated man with a halo gestures while wearing a long robe. Other figures in robes are seated around them, and a woman is seated reading or writing. The room has wooden beams on the ceiling and large windows. In the background, a part of the room is curtained off.

artworks.title: The Wedding at Cana (Christ Changes Water to Wine)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a banquet scene set in a classical architectural setting. The image depicts an interior with a large table surrounded by nine figures. The architectural space is defined by a series of arches and columns. The figures seem to be engaged in a feast or a gathering. The figures are engaged in conversation or enjoying a meal, as indicated by the presence of plates, cups, and large vases on the ground. The attire of the figures suggests a historical or classical theme. The ceiling features a coffered design, and through the archways, a landscape can be glimpsed. The drawing utilizes detailed line work and shading to convey texture and dimension in this historical tableau.

artworks.title: The Testimony of John
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a landscape with characters observing the scene. The image includes two figures in robes standing in the foreground, one gesturing towards a scene unfolding in the distance. The landscape features trees, a small settlement with houses, and a distant city on a hill. In the background, there are groups of figures and possibly some animals, depicted in a medieval or early Renaissance style. The drawing conveys a narrative, possibly depicting an event or a vision. The image is richly detailed, with an emphasis on texture, particularly in the rendering of trees and architectural features.

artworks.title: The Annunciation to the Shepherds
artworks.description: The image shows a detailed scene of shepherds gathered in a grassy terrain, surrounded by grazing sheep. In the background, there are rolling hills, trees, and a distant cityscape with various buildings and towers. An angelic figure descends from the sky at the top center of the image, surrounded by beams of light. The intricate linework and cross-hatching create texture and shading in a monochromatic color palette of sepia tones.

artworks.title: Michelangelo Buonarroti
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 26.8 x 20.1 cm (10 9/16 x 7 15/16 in.)
artworks.description: The artwork features a bust portrait of a man in an elaborate oval frame. The man is positioned slightly turned to his left, facing the viewer. He has a deeply marked face with prominent ridges and heavy lines, suggesting age. His hair is short, curly, and appears thinning, matching his curly beard. He wears a draped garment over his shoulders. Surrounding the portrait are ornate architectural elements, including scroll motifs and a stylized shell design at the top. An inscription in a serif font is found below the frame. Horizontal lines in the background add texture and depth.

artworks.title: The Rest on the Flight into Egypt
artworks.description: The image displays multiple figures. The central figure is a woman with wavy hair and a veil, cradling a nude child. Around them are several other figures, some with wings. One figure points upward. There is a man partially covered by drapery with curly hair and a beard, and another male figure with curly hair and a robe. The figures wear flowing robes. The backdrop features a rural landscape with buildings and hills. Above, cherubic figures are interwoven among the fronds of a palm tree. The background details create a rich tapestry framing the central figures.

artworks.title: The Three Fates
artworks.description: The image shows three women seated in various positions, depicted from head to feet, showcasing their full forms. The woman on the left is seated with her body facing slightly towards the center, holding a spindle in her right hand and a distaff in her left, dressed in draped, classical-style garments. Her hair is styled in elaborate curls around her head. The central figure is seated with crossed legs, leaning slightly to the left, wearing similar draped clothing. She holds a tool in her hands and has her hair pulled back. The third woman to the right is also seated, holding what appears to be a thread with her left hand, with her body turned slightly to the right. Her hair is wrapped in a headscarf, and she wears a gown. In the background, a simple linear texture adds depth to the image, with rectangular forms resembling books or plaques placed on the ground near the women's feet.

artworks.title: Allegorical Figure Holding a Sphere
artworks.artist: Giorgio Ghisi possibly after Giulio Romano
artworks.description: The image depicts a person standing in profile, facing left. The person has one arm bent upward holding a large round object and the other arm hanging by their side. The facial features are detailed, with a straight nose and a serene expression. The hair is intricately styled, braided, and piled on top of the head. The person is dressed in a flowing garment that wraps around their body, exposing one shoulder and partially flowing around the feet. The garment has soft, curving lines suggesting movement. The person has large wings extending from their back. The background has closely drawn parallel lines.

artworks.title: Jupiter
artworks.description: This is a black and white illustration showing a gathering of historically attired figures, including a bishop with a mitre and another figure with papal regalia. The scene also features two deities depicted above, one holding a staff and the other offering an object. Additional elements include peacocks, an architectural arch labeled "Jupiter," pillars, griffins, and scriptural elements intertwined within the composition.

artworks.title: Mars
artworks.description: The image shows an engraving of multiple figures in a gathering. The figures are depicted seated or standing in various poses, with detailed facial features, hairstyles, clothing, and accessories. The scene is surrounded by ornate borders with designs and cherub-like figures. Some characters hold objects like weapons and scrolls. In the background, there is a chariot pulled by horses and driven by an armored figure, set against clouds, rolling hills, and distant buildings. The top of the image is labeled "MARS," indicating a connection to the Roman god of war, with intricate engravings and foliage motifs throughout.

artworks.title: Mercury
artworks.description: This is a drawing depicting various figures engaged in musical and scholarly activities alongside mythological representations. The scene includes ornate depictions of roosters, a winged figure, and a classical chariot surrounded by clouds. The composition features architectural elements, intricate patterns, and decorative borders. Figures are shown playing a pipe organ, writing, and using astrological instruments. The imagery suggests themes of knowledge, music, and mythological symbolism, showcasing a Renaissance style of illustration.

artworks.title: Moon
artworks.description: This is a drawing featuring celestial and terrestrial elements. The central theme is lunar symbolism, with a crescent moon and the inscription "LVNA." A seated figure holds the crescent moon surrounded by decorative motifs. Below, figures engage in activities near water, possibly fishing or harvesting. There are architectural structures on the left and lush landscapes in the background. Various figures interact in a mythological and fantastic manner, including human forms and cherubic creatures riding sea creatures. The drawing is ornately framed with classical motifs, Latin inscriptions, and artistic flourishes.

artworks.title: Saturn
artworks.description: This is a drawing of Saturn in a celestial scene. Saturn is seated on a chariot pulled by a mythical creature, flying through the clouds. A cherubic figure is also present. Below, figures are engaged in different activities with an architectural backdrop, trees, and buildings. There are decorative elements and possibly Latin text in the image.

artworks.title: Venus
artworks.description: This is an image of Venus in an allegorical scene. Venus stands in a chariot drawn by birds, holding a spear, with other mythological figures nearby. Below, people in a lush landscape play musical instruments and engage in various activities. The image features ornate decorations, cherubs, and Latin inscriptions.

artworks.title: Coupin de La Couperie
artworks.description: The image depicts a three-quarter view of an upper body portrait of a man. He is turned slightly to the side with his head facing the viewer, showcasing his facial features. The man has wavy hair, distinct eyebrows, small eyes, a straight nose, and full lips. He is wearing a high-collared shirt, waistcoat, and dark double-breasted coat. The background is plain with no visible jewelry or objects.

artworks.title: The Agony in the Garden
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a scene with figures and a rural landscape. The image depicts several figures in a variety of activities, set within a countryside setting. The central figure is seen kneeling in front of a rocky outcrop with hands clasped in prayer. Surrounding them, other figures appear to be resting or sleeping on the ground. Additional figures in the background seem to be approaching from a distance, with some holding staffs or spears. A leafless tree and a chalice resting on the rock are also included in the illustration. The drawing showcases intricate line work, shading, and hatching to depict the figures' garments and the landscape, creating a detailed narrative.
